$source: holmes-gpt/src/app.css (PR #19 redesign), verified against the deployed stylesheet at ernestholmes.us

contrast.law: Two golds. --accent is text; --accentBright is fill. Full brand gold #F7B500 is never text and never white-on-gold.

sans.source: self-hosted variable woff2, ITF Free Font License

motion.reducedMotion: all animation and transition disabled globally

icons.note: no custom icon set; none should be drawn

logo.name: Book Sunrise
logo.colorLaw: Sun is always #F7B500 and never inverts. Book follows the ground: indigo on light, white on dark.
logo.clearspace: the radius of the sun's disc (~16% of mark height) on all sides
logo.minSize: 24px tall transparent mark; 32px for the tile; below that use the tile or no mark

files.darkGround: either tile — both are self-grounded; no transparent white-book file exists and none is needed
files.legacy: assets/legacy-* — pre-redesign serif lockup, not for use

logo.wordmark: live type: Satoshi Bold 'HolmesAI' + 0.75rem tagline in --ink-3; no current lockup file

canonical.note: Superseded by sizeLaw. 'Which drawing is canonical' was the wrong question — both are, at different sizes.
canonical.measured: Ray counts verified by gold connected-component analysis, validated against a render of the known five-ray tile.
canonical.sevenRayGeometry: 7 rays over 180 degrees at 30 degree spacing, disc r=26, rays at radius 40, ray width 7.5, in the mark's 200-unit coordinates.
canonical.rasterLadderWasAlwaysCorrect: icon-512/192/180.png carry the 7-ray geometry; bounding-box fit against the master agrees in x and y to five decimal places (1.60976 / 1.60968).

sizeLaw.rule: Seven rays wherever seven rays can be seen; five rays where they cannot. Both drawings are approved.

small.useAt: <32px, and every favicon/.ico whatever its frame size

sizeLaw.evidence: assets/variant-size-test.png — 16px: both collapse, 5-ray marginally better; 20-24px: clear win for 5-ray; 32px: both read; 48px+: 7-ray plainly finer.
sizeLaw.faviconNote: A favicon file ships one drawing across all its frames, so the .ico is 5-ray at 16, 32 and 48 alike; splitting drawings inside one .ico would change the icon's shape as the OS picks a frame.
sizeLaw.history: The 5-ray favicon was briefly re-cut to 7 rays on 2026-11-18 and reverted the same day: at 16px the 7 thin rays merged into a featureless mound. Ryan then set this law. Shipping favicons are byte-identical to their pre-re-cut originals.

supportDesk.note: SUPPORT_*_MARK is a public URL rendered as and as the favicon, not a repository path.
supportDesk.SUPPORT_ERNESTHOLMES_MARK: the canonical seven-ray mark, served publicly; light grounds only, so the desk's grounds must be pinned light
supportDesk.groundWarning: The desk themes itself dark under prefers-color-scheme. The brandbar ground is overridable per product, but the sign-in page mark and the favicon are not — both fall back to the desk's own theme.
